requirement.statement: The workbench SHALL execute selected requests through `POST /api/domain-operations/execute` and render the response envelope through distinct views for outcome, changes, before/after, operation tree, plan or SQL availability, and diagnostics, including partial batch item mapping when present.

case.given: a write preset with before, after, diff, trace, and plan observation channels
case.then: status, outcome, mutation summaries, probe snapshots, operation tree, public plan, and diagnostics SHALL be inspectable

case.given: a best-effort batch preset with one failing item
case.then: the response SHALL show partial status and stable item keys for success and failure rows

case.given: a business execution failure preset such as CancelEvent failure
case.then: failure diagnostics and the visible child-operation prefix SHALL be rendered without treating HTTP 200 as success-only UI state

case.given: runtime response facts mark SQL trace or batch item mapping unavailable
case.then: the workbench SHALL display the unavailable diagnostic or mapping state and SHALL NOT fabricate SQL or item outcomes
